title: So Mine's a Little Different
content: I love cruising and cruise ships (even though I've only been on one cruise in my life), so my "Mall World" is all too often a ship. She (ships are referred to by female pronouns) features a lot of amenities, probably many, many, many more than I've ever seen. One of the most common public rooms I'm in is kinda like the Central Park on Oasis Class ships (Royal Caribbean). Lotta plants, winding paths...
